svg.title: Zip-tie row spacing
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with hand size set to Custom, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: zip-tie row spacing at 12 mm: moves the second row of zip-tie holes closer to or farther from the first. Marked in red: 1, the wing openings: the two openings beside the pocket. 2, the zip-tie holes: the four small holes beside the pocket.
